guides.title: Context around the passage
guides.question: What does this person need to understand or find?
guides.summary: How much context does a reader need around the passage? Choosing the reading unit, landing in the right place, and keeping Scripture, notes and explanations distinct.

guides.title: Listening
guides.question: Can the practice continue when the screen is off?
guides.summary: Can the practice continue when the screen goes dark? Screen-off listening, read-along, chosen silence and an ending that lets the phone disappear.

guides.title: Trust in AI answers
guides.question: What authority might a fluent answer appear to have?
guides.summary: What authority does a fluent answer seem to have? Giving AI a bounded job, showing what it did, letting people check its sources, and keeping care in human hands.

guides.title: Attention and time
guides.question: What would “enough for now” look like?
guides.summary: What would “enough for now” look like? Reminders, emails, feeds and endings: asking for attention across every channel without taking more than was offered.

guides.title: Pricing and access
guides.question: What is being paid for, by whom, and what happens when the money stops?
guides.summary: Who pays for a faith app, and for what? What a Bible or faith app really costs, how ministries and businesses pay for it, and where the money can strain trust.

guides.title: Analytics
guides.question: What is the least sensitive evidence that could answer the question?
guides.summary: What is the least you need to know? Choosing metrics and research methods that answer product questions while protecting chats, prayers and reading histories.

guides.title: Community and visibility
guides.question: Who can see this, respond to it and exercise authority?
guides.summary: Who can see this, respond to it, and hold authority? Choosing the audience, accountability and moderation for shared plans, prayer requests, discussion and mentoring before adding a feed.

guides.title: Finding passages
guides.question: What does this person know already—and where should this action take them?
guides.summary: How does someone find the passage they are looking for? Reader controls, browsing, typed references, combined search fields and book order, as one journey into Scripture.

guides.title: How AI comes across
guides.question: What kind of presence does this interface lead someone to believe is here?
guides.summary: What kind of presence does the interface suggest is here? Names, avatars, typing dots, memory and disclosure in AI chat: warmth without mistaken identity.
